// @autogenerated
[#oauth-client]
= Oauth client

Application that signs users in or requests tokens through OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect. The client is sent in every authorization request, so the tenant is resolved from it.

== Dónde se encuentra

No aparece en el menú: se llega desde otra entidad.

== Campos

[cols="2,2,1,5",options="header"]
|===
|Campo |Tipo |Obligatorio |Detalles

|código
|Texto
|Sí
|Client identifier (client_id) used in the OAuth requests.

|inquilino
|Tenant (referencia)
|No
|Owner tenant. Empty for a global client, manageable only by the root tenant.

|permitir todos los ámbitos
|Sí / no
|No
|Lets the client request any scope instead of only the standard OpenID Connect ones.

|método de autenticación de punto final de token
|Opción de una lista
|Sí
|How the client authenticates at the token endpoint: client secret in the Authorization header or in the body, a signed JWT (private_key_jwt), or none for public clients. Valores posibles: «client_secret_basic», «client_secret_post», «private_key_jwt», «nada». Valor inicial: «client_secret_basic».

|token endpoint auth firma alg
|Texto
|No
|Algorithm the client uses to sign the JWT with which it authenticates at the token endpoint. Valor inicial: «RS256».

|tokens de acceso vinculados a dpop
|Sí / no
|Sí
|Requires the access tokens of this client to be bound to a DPoP key (RFC 9449). Valor inicial: «false».

|id token signed response alg
|Opción de una lista
|No
|Algorithm used to sign the ID tokens issued to this client. Valores posibles: «RS256», «ES256», «EdDSA». Valor inicial: «RS256».

|tls cliente auth asunto dn
|Texto
|No
|Expected subject DN of the client certificate for mutual-TLS client authentication (RFC 8705).

|tokens de acceso vinculados a certificados de cliente tls
|Sí / no
|Sí
|Binds the access tokens of this client to its TLS client certificate (RFC 8705). Valor inicial: «false».

|autorización firmada respuesta alg
|Texto
|No
|Algorithm used to sign JWT-secured authorization responses (JARM) for this client.

|modo de entrega de token de backchannel
|Opción de una lista
|No
|How tokens are delivered in the CIBA flow: the client polls the token endpoint, or receives a ping. Valores posibles: «encuesta», «ping».

|punto final de notificación de cliente de backchannel
|Texto
|No
|Endpoint of the client that receives the CIBA ping notifications.

|Tipo Materias
|Opción de una lista
|Sí
|Subject identifier sent to the client: the same for every client (public) or a different one per sector (pairwise). Valores posibles: «público», «Por pares». Valor inicial: «público».

|id token respuesta cifrada alg
|Texto
|No
|Key management algorithm used to encrypt the ID tokens of this client; empty sends them unencrypted.

|id token respuesta cifrada enc
|Texto
|No
|Content encryption algorithm used to encrypt the ID tokens of this client.

|userinfo respuesta cifrada alg
|Texto
|No
|Key management algorithm used to encrypt the userinfo responses of this client; empty sends them unencrypted.

|userinfo respuesta cifrada enc
|Texto
|No
|Content encryption algorithm used to encrypt the userinfo responses of this client.

|tipos de detalles de autorización
|Texto largo
|No
|JSON list of the authorization_details types the client can request (RFC 9396).

|userinfo respuesta firmada alg
|Texto
|No
|Algorithm used to sign the userinfo responses; empty returns them as plain JSON.

|oauth secreto
|Texto
|No
|Client secret; only its digest is stored.

|token de acceso de registro
|Texto
|No
|Token the client uses to manage its own registration (RFC 7592); only its digest is stored.

|valores acr predeterminados
|Texto
|No
|Authentication context class (ACR) values requested by default when the client does not send acr_values.

|edad máxima predeterminada
|Número entero
|No
|Maximum authentication age, in seconds, applied when the client does not send max_age.

|identificador de sector URI
|Texto
|No
|URL listing the redirect URIs of the clients that share pairwise subject identifiers.

|redireccionamientos de inicio de sesión permitidos
|Lista de oauth client allowed login redirect (referencia)
|Sí
|Redirect URIs the client may use after sign-in.

|redireccionamientos de cierre de sesión permitidos
|Lista de oauth client allowed logout redirect (referencia)
|Sí
|Redirect URIs the client may use after sign-out.

|audiencias permitidas
|Lista de oauth client allowed audience (referencia)
|Sí
|Audiences (resource servers or resource URIs) the client may request tokens for.

|Tipos de concesión
|Texto largo
|No
|JSON list of the grant types the client may use. Valor inicial: «["authorization_code","refresh_token"]».

|introspección permitida
|Sí / no
|Sí
|If true, this client is allowed to call the token introspection endpoint (POST /introspect) to validate access tokens. Resource servers must authenticate at the introspection endpoint using their client credentials. Valor inicial: «false».

|requerir solicitudes de autorización push
|Sí / no
|Sí
|Requires the client to send its authorization requests through PAR (RFC 9126). Valor inicial: «false».

|Solicitar clave PKCE
|Sí / no
|Sí
|If true, every authorization code request from this client must include code_challenge and code_challenge_method=S256. For clients with public-allow=true, PKCE is always required regardless of this flag. Valor inicial: «false».

|uRI de cierre de sesión de backchannel
|Texto
|No
|Endpoint of the client that receives back-channel logout notifications.

|sesión de cierre de sesión de backchannel requerida
|Sí / no
|No
|Includes the session identifier (sid) in the back-channel logout token.

|uRI de cierre de sesión de frontchannel
|Texto
|No
|URL of the client loaded in the browser to sign the user out (front-channel logout).

|sesión de cierre de sesión de frontchannel requerida
|Sí / no
|No
|Adds the issuer and session identifier to the front-channel logout URL.

|habilitado
|Sí / no
|Sí
|A disabled client cannot sign in users or obtain tokens, without deleting it. Valor inicial: «false». Lo calcula la aplicación: no se edita.

|nombre del cliente
|Texto
|No
|Name of the client shown to users, for example on the consent screen.

|URI de logo
|Texto
|No
|URL of the client logo shown to users.

|uRI del cliente
|Texto
|No
|URL of the home page of the client.

|uRI de la política
|Texto
|No
|URL of the privacy policy of the client.

|tos URI
|Texto
|No
|URL of the terms of service of the client.

|Tipos de respuesta
|Texto largo
|No
|JSON list of the response types the client may request.

|registrado dinámicamente
|Sí / no
|No
|The client was created through dynamic client registration (RFC 7591).

|domiciliado de
|Fecha y hora
|No
|When the client was registered.

|ámbitos de credenciales de cliente
|Texto largo
|No
|Scopes granted to the client in the client credentials flow.

|token de credenciales de cliente ttl segundos
|Número entero
|Sí
|Lifetime, in seconds, of the access tokens issued in the client credentials flow. Valor inicial: «3600».

|solicitar objeto firmando alg
|Texto
|No
|Algorithm the client must use to sign request objects.

|uRI de jwks
|Texto largo
|No
|URL of the JSON Web Key Set with the public keys of the client.

|jwks json
|Texto largo
|No
|JSON Web Key Set with the public keys of the client, when it does not publish a jwks-uri.
|===

== Acciones

[cols="1,3",options="header"]
|===
|Acción |Qué hace

|Crear
|Da de alta un elemento nuevo.

|Consultar
|Muestra los valores de un elemento.

|Editar
|Cambia los valores de un elemento.

|Borrar
|Borra un elemento, o los seleccionados, tras confirmarlo.

|Enable
|Deja _habilitado_ en «true».

|Disable
|Deja _habilitado_ en «false».
|===

== Validaciones

Además de los campos obligatorios, al guardar se comprueban estas reglas. Si alguna no se cumple, el formulario marca los campos implicados con el mensaje y no deja guardar.

* No puede haber dos elementos con _inquilino_ y _código_ iguales.
